title: docs(security): document ban projection and generation ownership
body:
## Exact prerequisite scope

At current remote master `b19b3dc715691b871f0e3cab598ec5da8f27633c`, the retained original full C# style execution reports17 XML-documentation findings in `src/backend/Infrastructure/Security/BanStateProjection.cs`. The file is byte-identical to the measured baseline source. This is an executed historical diagnostic binding, not fresh full-style acceptance. Fresh OPEN PR and existing-worktree status inventories found no overlap. Separate from #3549's20 AdminSessionProjection declarations.

## Implementation

Add meaningful XML docs for the exact17 declarations, including the internal InterlockedExtensions.Max helper. Document actual projection lookup, generation/readiness, local application and monotonic CAS behavior. Keep visibility and the existing implementation unchanged; do not invent external guarantees or convert observed memory accounting into a total-heap quota. No runtime tokens, public contract, policy/checker/baseline, tests or test-oracle changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Seal exact base/head,17 original findings and declaration roster.
- [ ] Independently review docs against actual methods and current security/architecture norms.
- [ ] Preserve complete noncomment source tokens/signatures and every existing test/oracle.
- [ ] Actual scoped C# style, docs/intent, build/relevant projection behavior checks, matrix and current-head change-contract gates pass; missing/global RED lanes remain explicit.
- [ ] Normal independent PR review/merge and current-master recheck before closure.

No policy bootstrap, debt waiver, candidate self-admission or trusted-baseline promotion. Preserve prior RED evidence. Roll back inaccurate documentation through a normal PR.
